text:
maria: Quick UX question — for the new Connect form, should we keep only the red asterisk for required fields or also include a visible "(required)" label for screen readers? trying to keep the form tight but want strong a11y coverage.

sam: i'm leaning to asterisk + visually-hidden 'required' string. aria-required="true" is helpful, but some SRs don't expose asterisks so the hidden text ensures clarity.

alan: agree with sam. another option: use aria-describedby to point to help text that says 'required' so it reads inline with the label. avoids extra visual noise.

tia: can we do a small pill for required (like 'Required') next to the label? less noisy than full '(required)' and visible for mouse users. design ops worried about repeated pills in dense forms.

maria: mock: https://figma.redwood/team/conn-form — shows pill variant and asterisk-only. also concerned about error placement: inline below field vs a top summary.

sam: practical rule: inline errors under field for single-field issues; show a focusable error summary at top if submit returns multiple errors (anchor to first). keeps both keyboard and SR flows good.

alan: also for screen reader behavior we should update a live region on validation errors so SR announces field errors on submit. simplest pattern: aria-live="assertive" on an offscreen container with error text.

tia: quick note on destructive confirms (delete resource): typed-confirm is safest but super heavy. maybe default to checkbox + clear microcopy unless it's critical data. also trap focus and set aria-modal.

maria: thinking about microcopy — product wants minimal friction on signup-esque flows. can we only mark required fields that are actually required at API level and leave others blank? reduces noise.

sam: propose pattern doc bullets we can land:
- use aria-required on form controls (always)
- include visually-hidden 'required' for SRs (unless label already says 'optional')
- keep a single inline error under field
- show a top error summary with links for multi-error submit
- use aria-live for announcing submit-time errors
- use checkbox confirm for most deletes, reserve typed-confirm for high-risk destructive actions

tia: +1. can we run a quick JAWS/NVDA check next sprint? i'll pair with a11y eng and validate the final copy.

alan: i'll update the Figma spec with both asterisk + visually-hidden variant and the pill option, add code snippets for aria-describedby and live region.

deploy-bot: staging preview: https://staging.redwood/changes/conn-form-aria — mock deployed to staging :rocket:

maria: thanks — i'll consolidate comments and open a tiny RFC with recommended pattern and copy examples. :thumbsup:
